input: Reupholster the dining room chair cushions

gold.taskTitle: Reupholster the Dining Room Chair Cushions
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to reupholster the cushions on their dining room chairs.

questions.title: How many chairs need new cushions?
questions.description: Determine the total number of dining chairs the user needs to reupholster.

questions.title: Are the cushions removable or attached to the chair frame?
questions.description: Understand whether the cushions can be detached for easier reupholstering or are fixed.

questions.title: Have you already chosen the replacement fabric?
questions.description: Find out if the user has selected a fabric or still needs guidance on choosing one.

questions.title: Will you do this yourself or hire a professional?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a DIY project or the user intends to outsource the work.

questions.title: Does the foam or padding also need replacing?
questions.description: Determine if only the fabric covering needs updating or if the underlying cushion material is worn too.

questions.title: What is your target budget for this project?
questions.description: Understand the financial constraints to recommend appropriate materials or professional services.

questions.title: When do you need this project completed by?
questions.description: Establish the user's deadline or desired timeframe to help prioritize steps.
